name: Paradigm of Sloth
description: You can lumber, moving 10% slower and gaining slow, [effect:attacks][dark-gray]massive attacks[/dark-gray][/effect], [dark-red]but[/dark-red] lumbering replaces sprinting.

effects.explanation: You can perform massive attacks after sprinting for 1.5 seconds. They have -66% total attack speed but strike on any swing in a 5-block radius, applying 2.5x damage and a brief stun, then 1 second of -20% speed.
